## Problem

What can't you do today that you wish you could? Skip the proposed solution for a moment — describe the gap.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If you're proposing a new capability module (sensors, calendar, etc.), describe the API you'd want exposed to spells (`window.AppacadabraXxx.method(...)`).

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the same problem. Helps us understand the design space.

## Additional context

Use cases, similar features in other apps, mockups, anything else.
